Proposition
[the operator $S_\eta $ via the covariant derivative]

↗ def:dc-ch6-2-2 ↗ def:dc-ch6-3-normal-connection ↗ lem:dc-ch6-3-weingarten ↗ lem:dc-ch6-2-locality

1. ch6:2.3Let $p\in M$, $x\in T_pM$ and $\eta \in (T_pM)^\perp $. Let $N$ be a local extension of $\eta $ normal to $M$. Then

\[ S_\eta (x)=-(\overline{ abla }_x N)^T. \]
Proof

\sketch Let $y\in T_pM$ and let $X,Y$ be local extensions of $x,y$, tangent to $M$. Then $\langle N,Y angle =0$, and therefore

\[ \langle S_\eta (x),y angle =\langle B(X,Y)(p),N angle =\langle \overline{ abla }_X Y- abla _X Y,N angle (p)=\langle \overline{ abla }_X Y,N angle (p)=-\langle Y,\overline{ abla }_X N angle (p)=\langle -\overline{ abla }_x N,y angle , \]

for all $y\in T_pM$.

□
